title: Webhook signature forgery, replay and encoding validation
attackSurface: Byte-exact webhook deliveries verified before JSON parsing or business logic

hostile.title: GitHub wrong-secret signature
hostile.why: A well-shaped signature made with the wrong secret must not verify

hostile.title: GitHub malformed hex signature
hostile.why: Non-hex signature text must be rejected before comparison

hostile.title: Stripe stale timestamp replay
hostile.why: An old captured Stripe delivery is outside the replay tolerance

hostile.title: Stripe future timestamp
hostile.why: A timestamp too far in the future indicates clock or replay abuse

hostile.title: Slack missing signature header
hostile.why: A webhook with no signature has no proof of origin

hostile.title: Shopify noncanonical base64
hostile.why: Encoding confusion must not become a signature acceptance oracle

hostile.title: Linear ambiguous multi-value header
hostile.why: Duplicate single-value signature headers are ambiguous and must fail closed

hostile.title: Standard Webhooks replayed delivery
hostile.why: A previously verified delivery cannot be accepted a second time when replay protection is enabled

benign.title: Valid GitHub delivery
benign.why: Correct raw-body HMAC with the current secret

benign.title: GitHub previous-secret rotation
benign.why: Zero-downtime rotation accepts the previous secret while it remains configured

benign.title: Valid Stripe delivery
benign.why: Correct timestamped Stripe signature inside tolerance

benign.title: Valid Slack delivery
benign.why: Correct Slack versioned signature and timestamp

benign.title: Valid Standard Webhooks delivery
benign.why: Correct message-id, timestamp and base64 signature combination

benign.title: Valid Discord interaction
benign.why: Correct Ed25519 interaction signature over timestamp and raw body
